ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status), /* Only fire when Status is changed */ ISPICKVAL(Status, "Launch-Ready"), /* AND the new Status is "Launch Ready" */ NOT( /* AND NOT ALL of the following conditions are met (i.e., at least one is FALSE) */ AND( ISPICKVAL(Legal_Entity_Exists__c, "Yes"), ISPICKVAL(Staffing_Capacity__c, "Full Time"), ISPICKVAL(Seed_Funding_Secured__c, "Yes"), OR( ISPICKVAL(Strategic_Plan_Developed__c, "Yes"), ISPICKVAL(Strategic_Plan_Developed__c, "In Progress") ), OR( ISPICKVAL(Relationships_with_Local_Programs__c, "Strong"), ISPICKVAL(Relationships_with_Local_Programs__c, "Moderate") ), ISPICKVAL(Funding_Stability__c, "Low Risk") ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please ensure the following fields are properly completed: Legal Entity Exists, Staffing Capacity, Seed Funding Secured, Strategic Plan Developed, Relationships with Local Programs, Funding Stability
